requirements.statement: The app displays a single web page showing the current date and time.

criteria.must: Loading the app's URL renders a single page.
The rendered page shows the current date.
The rendered page shows the current time.

requirements.statement: The displayed date and time update automatically (live) without requiring a manual page refresh.

criteria.must: The displayed time value changes on its own within a few seconds of the page remaining open, with no user action.

requirements.statement: The date and time reflect the visitor's own browser/device clock and locale/timezone, with no server-side time source.

criteria.must: The displayed date and time are derived from the visitor's local browser clock rather than a value fetched from a backend.

requirements.statement: The app makes no calls to any backend or third-party API.

criteria.must: No network requests to a backend service or third-party API are made while the page is loaded and running.

requirements.statement: The page is viewable by any visitor without signing in or authenticating.

criteria.must: The page and its date/time display are accessible without any login or authentication step.

requirements.statement: The app has no persistence: nothing is stored across visits or reloads.

criteria.must: No visit history, preferences, or other data are stored or retrievable across page reloads.

requirements.statement: The application is a single-page app with a single view and no additional routes.

criteria.must: The app exposes exactly one view/route; there is no navigation to additional pages.
